test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following diagram, A contains all the people who like chocolate, B contains all the people who like ice-cream and C contains all the people who like candy. What does the shaded area represent?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62b415e14a9b58b463d8edac8d0fae542f9a6481d99f1827d15cc55809902653.png]

options.text: People who only like chocolate and candy.
People who only like chocolate and ice-cream.
People who only like candy and ice-cream.
People who like chocolate, candy and ice-cream.

solution:
**Explanation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85553996ba87c9a3c9c112b224ddf46e9a1109498c727ff0347642df4373d323.png] 

The shaded part represents the people who like chocolate, candy and ice-cream.

**The correct answer is "People who like chocolate, candy and ice-cream."**
